title: Database connection timeouts

steps.title: Check database connection pool saturation
steps.description: Compare active vs maximum pool connections for the affected service and look for connection wait queues.

steps.title: Check database health and slow queries
steps.description: Review database CPU, locks and the slow-query log for the incident window.

steps.title: Increase connection pool size or timeout temporarily
steps.description: Raise the pool limit or acquisition timeout within database capacity; revert after the incident.

steps.title: Fail over to a healthy database replica
steps.description: Promote or route traffic to a healthy replica if the primary is degraded.

escalation: Database on-call if timeouts persist for more than 15 minutes or affect payments.
